blocks.text: 2 April. Breakfast at the hotel. Today you will visit the Shrine of Our Lady of Guadalupe, take part in Holy Mass and continue exploring Mexico at the National Museum of Anthropology. The full route is given in the guided tour below. Return to the hotel for dinner and an overnight stay at Casa Blanca 4* or a similar hotel.
